reviewed_by: Claude: Butler panels skewed in phone-width Butler mode; no code editor in the iPhone app
reason: CSS and Butler mode page change. The iPhone app drops Code & files (section tabs, More sheet, section=code falls back to Board, brief file chips become plain names). Selected the Butler mode board unit suite (new shell test) and the iPhone shell Playwright area, whose mocked journey now asserts the lent settings and project-thread panels sit inside the screen and that Code & files is absent, plus the Butler mode real-Core journey at phone width.
exclusions: No Core, Python or native change. Desktop layout is unchanged by the media-scoped rules; full suites not run.
